'''Kallidah''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] located in the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Archaeological Research Council/Legends|Archaeological Research Council]] established a [[Polis Massa Research Base|Research Base]] on the nearby [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] colony to try and uncover evidence of an evolutionary link between the Kallidahin and the extinct [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]] natives. Later, the entire population of Kallidah abandoned their homeworld and moved to Polis Massa to work on the project.
